text:
zoe: photo drop! Prickles (our hedgehog) completed an obstacle course made from cereal boxes and a hair scrunchie tunnel. he slowed dramatically at the finish line like a champion :hedgehog: (pic attached)

anish: that tiny sweater!!! where did you get it?? :heart_eyes: :sweat_smile:

zoe: handmade by my aunt. it has a little leaf applique. she insists on calling it 'festival knit' 

kelly: vote: name the sweater: 1) Punkle (punk + Prickles) 2) The Leaflet 3) Speedy Snug. react 1/2/3 or reply other

bryce: 1 for the attitude.

ops-bot: zoe added a file: prickles-sweater-finish.jpg (720KB)

anish: is the course permanent? asking for a friend who wants to arrange competitive hedgehog trials :trophy:

zoe: temporary. made from recycled boxes. the scrunchie tunnel is the crowd favorite. pro tip: tape the edges so they don't snag his feet.

kelly: audio bed needed. someone make a tiny victory fanfare for Prickles.

bryce: i'll try a 5s chiptune and drop it later.

zoe: he accepted a single blueberry as a prize and then fell asleep on the sweater like he owned it. will post nap pic later.

anish: this is the wholesome content i signed up for today. thanks for making my afternoon.

kelly: tiny hedgehog olympics when? monthly? weekly?

zoe: monthly works for me. i'll add a calendar event "Small Pets, Big Wins" and invite the channel.

ops-bot: zoe created event: Small Pets, Big Wins (recurring monthly)

bryce: i'll audition my chiptune by then. Prickles deserves an anthem. :notes:
